SELECT r.student_id FROM advisor_student_relation r JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = r.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.student_id WHERE r.advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND r.deleted = 0
AND sp.development_intention = #{path}
AND (sp.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_goal g1 WHERE g1.student_id = r.student_id AND g1.goal_type = 'PRIMARY' AND g1.status = 'ACTIVE' AND g1.direction_id = #{directionId} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_goal g2 WHERE g2.student_id = r.student_id AND g2.goal_type = 'PRIMARY' AND g2.status = 'ACTIVE' )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_goal g3 WHERE g3.student_id = r.student_id AND g3.goal_type = 'PRIMARY' AND g3.status = 'ACTIVE' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stage_review rv1 WHERE rv1.student_id = r.student_id AND rv1.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND rv1.submitted_at >= #{monthStart} )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stage_review rv2 WHERE rv2.student_id = r.student_id AND rv2.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND rv2.submitted_at >= #{thirtyDaysAgo} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stage_review rv3 WHERE rv3.student_id = r.student_id AND rv3.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND rv3.advisor_requested = 1 AND (rv3.advisor_reply IS NULL OR rv3.advisor_reply = '') )
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM assessment_session WHERE status = 'SCORED' AND student_id IN
#{sid}

SELECT DISTINCT student_id FROM stage_review WHERE status = 'SUBMITTED' AND advisor_requested = 1 AND (advisor_reply IS NULL OR advisor_reply = '') AND student_id IN
#{sid}

SELECT user_id AS student_id, name, class_name, completeness, development_intention, updated_at FROM student_profile WHERE user_id IN
#{sid}

SELECT id, student_id, source_version, dimension_json, summary, strengths_json, explore_json, feedback_json, version_no, completeness, created_at FROM profile_snapshot WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.student_id, r.profile_snapshot_id, r.rule_version, r.status, r.generated_at, ps.version_no AS profile_version FROM recommendation_run r LEFT JOIN profile_snapshot ps ON ps.id = r.profile_snapshot_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT run_id, direction_id, score, `rank`, confidence, reasons_json, strengths_json, gaps_json, semester_actions_json, feedback_json FROM recommendation_result WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY `rank` ASC

SELECT id, student_id, version_no, status, source, goal_summary, semester_goals_json, monthly_tasks_json, notes_json, confirmed_at, updated_at FROM semester_plan WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY created_at DESC, version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, plan_id, student_id, month, title, task_type, est_hours, status, deadline, ability_tags_json, note, created_at FROM plan_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY month ASC, created_at ASC

SELECT id, student_id, cycle, status, content_json, ai_summary, ai_suggest_json, advisor_requested, advisor_reply, submitted_at FROM stage_review WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advisor_student_relation WHERE advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.student_id) FROM advisor_student_relation r JOIN assessment_session s ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND s.status = 'SCORED' WHERE r.advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.student_id) FROM advisor_student_relation r JOIN semester_plan p ON p.student_id = r.student_id AND p.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE r.advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.student_id) FROM advisor_student_relation r JOIN stage_review rv ON rv.student_id = r.student_id AND rv.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND rv.submitted_at >= #{monthStart} WHERE r.advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.development_intention, ''), 'undecided') AS path, COUNT(*) AS count FROM advisor_student_relation r LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = r.student_id WHERE r.advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.development_intention, ''), 'undecided')

SELECT pt.student_id, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN pt.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_tasks FROM advisor_student_relation r JOIN plan_task pt ON pt.student_id = r.student_id JOIN semester_plan sp ON sp.id = pt.plan_id AND sp.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE r.advisor_id = #{advisorId} AND r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY pt.student_id
